column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST across two tests: mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- four, not six, because CannotWriteThroughQuery has TWO postgres subtests (with and without a tenant in context) and both run here. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: CannotWriteThroughQuery/{mysql,mssql}, StillReads/{mysql,mssql}; passed: CannotWriteThroughQuery/postgres_no_tenant, /postgres_with_tenant, StillReads/postgres), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. Guards cleat#1621: ReadOnlyDB.Query ran on the BARE POOL whenever beginTenantTx declined -- any non-PostgreSQL dialect, and PostgreSQL with no tenant -- so a mutating statement reached the database through a read-only handle. postgres_no_tenant is the subtest that matters: the dialect every CI job runs, unprotected on the path plugins actually take.
